_om: Detektiven in English (Sleuth, rusj.no/en/sleuth/): Who am I? and 20 questions. Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. The secrets are in data.en/hemmeligheter.json, written for the UK. Shared words come from rusj/kit/tekst.en.json.
Én har hemmeligheten. Detektivene spør –: One player has the secret. The detectives ask – and battle for points.
Du vet ikke hva du er! De andre vet det: You don't know what you are! The others do – and answer.
Samarbeid uten poeng. Hvor få spørsmål t: Teamwork, no points. How few questions do you need?
Bare lette hemmeligheter – perfekt for b: Only easy secrets – perfect for children.
Lette og middels vanskelige – passer de: Easy and medium – suits most people.
Hemmeligheten går på rundgang, og alle d: The secret goes round the table, and everyone else asks.
Everyone gets to hold the secret {ganger}.
{t} av {n} rekker å gjette – bare de er: {t} of {n} get to guess – only they are in the results.
{t} of {n} get to hold the secret.
Not everyone gets to guess the same number of times.
Ikke alle får ha hemmeligheten like mang: Not everyone gets to hold the secret the same number of times.
Vi oppklarte {n} av {hemmeligheter} – ra: We cracked {n} of {hemmeligheter} – the fastest in {spm}!
Ingen av {hemmeligheter} ble oppklart. K: None of {hemmeligheter} was cracked. Can you do better?
{navn} spør – dere andre svarer med knap: {navn} asks – the rest of you answer with the buttons.
Detektivene spør – du svarer med knappen: The detectives ask – you answer with the buttons.
Alle 20 spørsmålene er brukt. Siste sjan: All 20 questions are used up. Last chance to guess.
Noen har en hemmelighet – og den skal fi: Someone has a secret – and it has to be found with yes/no questions. 20 at most!
I «20 spørsmål» holder én inne kortet og: In ‘20 questions’ one player holds the card and sees the secret. In ‘Who am I?’ it's the other way round: everyone sees the card – except the one who has to guess.
Spør etter tur: «Er det et dyr?» Svar Ja: Take turns to ask: ‘Is it an animal?’ Answer Yes, No or Maybe – the phone counts the questions.
Tror du at du vet svaret? Gjett – det te: Think you know? Guess – it counts as a question too. Right? Tap the big button.
I «20 spørsmål» gir riktig gjetning 2 po: In ‘20 questions’ a right guess scores 2 points. Solved in 10 questions or fewer? Then the other detectives get 1 point each.
Den med hemmeligheten får 1 poeng hvis d: The one with the secret gets 1 point if it lasts 15 questions, 2 if it lasts all 20 – and 3 if nobody gets it.
I «Hvem er jeg?» får den som gjetter, 3: In ‘Who am I?’ the guesser gets 3 points for getting it in 10 questions, 2 in 15 and 1 in 20.
«Alle mot hemmeligheten» er uten poeng:: ‘Everyone v the secret’ has no points: you work together to use as few questions as possible.
Gjetter du feil, står du over neste spør: Guess wrong and you sit out the next question. So wild guesses don't pay.
Etter 10 og 15 spørsmål kan dere få et h: After 10 and 15 questions you can get a hint. Not sure of the answer? Tap ‘Maybe’.
The secret goes round the table.
Etter 10 og 15 spørsmål kan detektivene: After 10 and 15 questions the detectives can get a little hint.
Nå skal denne gjette: Now it's this player's turn to guess
Vis kortet til de andre: Show the card to the others
New secret – hold to see it.
Ready? The guesser can turn round now.
Everyone except the guesser gets to look.
Husk den godt – og hold pokerfjes!: Remember it well – and keep a poker face!
Let go and it hides again.
Hold fingeren på kortet for å se: Hold your finger on the card to see
Ukjent for dere? Trekk en ny: Don't know it? Draw a new one
Kjenner du den ikke? Trekk en ny: Don't know it? Draw a new one
De andre detektivene får 1 hver for godt: The other detectives get 1 each for good teamwork.
{navn} får {n} for å ha holdt ut i alle: {navn} gets {n} for holding out all 20 questions.
Ny rekord: {n} løst på rad!: New record: {n} solved in a row!
Hemmelighetene holdt. Prøv igjen – nå kj: The secrets held. Try again – now you know the tricks!
Likt på poeng – {navn} brukte færrest sp: Level on points – {navn} used the fewest questions.
Likt på poeng – raskeste oppklaring avgj: Level on points – the fastest crack decided it.
Bare de som rakk å gjette, er med i kåri: Only those who got to guess are in the results.
Bare for dere som svarer – {navn} ser bo: Only for those answering – {navn} looks away!
Bare for den som har hemmeligheten!: Only for the one with the secret!

Hemmeligheten blir avslørt. {navn} får {.one: The secret is revealed. {navn} gets {n} point for holding out 15 questions.
Hemmeligheten blir avslørt. {navn} får {.other: The secret is revealed. {navn} gets {n} points for holding out 15 questions.

Hemmeligheten blir avslørt, og ingen får: The secret is revealed, and nobody scores for it.
Hemmeligheten blir avslørt, og {navn} få: The secret is revealed, and {navn} gets no points for it.
Hemmeligheten blir avslørt og teller som: The secret is revealed and counts as unsolved.
You'll go straight to the results.
You'll go straight to the report.
Ingen hemmeligheter er avslørt ennå, så: No secrets have been revealed yet, so the game will just disappear.
Hemmeligheten dere holder på med, teller: The secret you're on doesn't count.
